title: super health indicator
body:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c96ac1624161b8d6027f4991de63933db880e432.png)

Adds other player's health on hover. 

Settings:
- Draw healthbar - on hover draws enemy's healthbar
- Draw max health - Draws enemy's max health
- Draw health in nametags - draws health in player's nametags
- Show self health - draws your actual health above the crosshair
- Show prediction - shows W if your hp is more than enemies hp, L if less and D if the same
- Always show 5s after hit - shows hp not only when aiming, but also within 5 seconds after hit
- Color health text - colors health text
- Scale text when low health - if enemy has low hp the text under crosshair would get bigger

![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d86103f60a355c4196598e1295e9536ff32af1d2.png)

Dependencies:
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/versions)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
